design_brief_zh: 主卖点是箱内双区分隔与X型固定带，重点展示如何让衣物分类并保持稳定；事实证据为双区结构、X型固定带和干湿分离袋，禁止延伸为防水、密封或防漏。PC画布1464×600：左侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.1,0.38,0.8]，按标题、支持说明、证据/细节1、证据/细节2自上而下排列；右侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]，展示打开的旅行箱内衬、双区隔层、X型固定带及干湿分离袋，产品略向左转约15°，确保结构可见。移动端1200×900：上方产品与轻量旅行场景区[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，下方文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]，保持标题→说明→两条细节的阅读顺序。使用低饱和中性色、自然侧光和柔和阴影，突出涤纶内衬纹理与分隔结构；字体采用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线体，标题加粗，细节短句清晰，德语预留约20%横向扩展。第1行对应整体双区收纳，第2行对应X型固定带与双区结构，第3行对应干湿分离袋，第4行对应干湿衣物分离收益。创意方向要求提及TSA密码设置详情，但现有资料只确认有TSA密码锁，未提供具体设置步骤或图示证据，因此不在图片中虚构步骤；如保留锁的局部，仅作真实硬件辅助，不添加操作说明或未经证实的功能。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的双区分隔、X型固定带和干湿分离袋事实；不得声称防水、防漏、绝对稳固或提供未证实的密码设置步骤。不得使用竞品商标、虚构认证、评分、官方背书或促销信息。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ full-image module for the YWJ 13A travel suitcase, using a European modern travel photography style, low-saturation neutral colors, and soft natural side lighting. PC layout: 1464x600, open suitcase on the right in [0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84], angled about 15 degrees left so the interior is clearly visible; reserve a clean, low-detail text area on the left in [0.05,0.1,0.38,0.8]. Show the verified polyester lining, two interior packing zones, X-shaped retention straps, and the included dry-wet separation bag with dry and damp clothing visibly separated but presented naturally. The visual should communicate organized packing and separated clothing without implying waterproofing, leakproofing, or absolute security. Mobile layout: product and light travel context in the upper area [0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53], with a clean lower text area [0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]. Use realistic product proportions, accurate suitcase structure, soft shadows, and clear close-up evidence of the interior details. A TSA lock may appear only as a secondary authentic hardware detail; do not depict or invent password-setting steps because no verified step sequence is supplied. Follow the reading order: headline, supporting explanation, dry-wet bag detail, clothing-separation benefit. Render NO text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, icons, badges, competitor marks, or UI elements in the image.
